Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of your class. I have a call at 4:40, so start with why nobody called me first.
I wasn't asked to come in. I was told about a zero, so I came. Why did it go into the gradebook before anyone called me?
I'm sorry? I have a client call in eighteen minutes. Owen.
If you need to stop, stop. Otherwise, Owen. Why was the zero entered before I was called?
